card.line: Moreh is a hill in the valley area where Gideon's story takes place. The camp of Midian was near it when Gideon faced them.

moments.title: Midian camps near Moreh
moments.text: Gideon and his men camped beside the spring of Harod. The camp of Midian was north of them in the valley near the hill of Moreh. Then the LORD told Gideon he had too many men and cut the army down to three hundred.
